name: wordcraft-writer
description: A distraction-free prose editor inside VS Code. Write .md and .txt files with word count goals, real-time stats, and code-like syntax coloring by part of speech.

commands.title: WordCraft: Choose Status Bar Items to Display

wordcraft.enableOnStartup.description: Automatically activate WordCraft stats when opening a .md or .txt file.

wordcraft.wordGoal.min.description: Minimum word count goal. A warning appears when you are below this number.

wordcraft.wordGoal.max.description: Maximum word count goal. The progress bar fills to 100% at this number.

wordcraft.statusBar.showWordCount.description: Show word count in the status bar.

wordcraft.statusBar.showCharCount.description: Show character count in the status bar.

wordcraft.statusBar.showSentenceCount.description: Show sentence count in the status bar.

wordcraft.statusBar.showParagraphCount.description: Show paragraph count in the status bar.

wordcraft.statusBar.showReadingTime.description: Show estimated reading time in the status bar.

wordcraft.statusBar.showProgressBar.description: Show a visual progress bar toward word goal in the status bar.

wordcraft.highlighting.enabled.description: Enable part-of-speech syntax coloring (verbs, nouns, adjectives, etc.).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorNouns.description: Color nouns (similar to HTML element color in code themes).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorVerbs.description: Color verbs (similar to function/keyword color in code themes).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorAdjectives.description: Color adjectives (similar to string color in code themes).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorAdverbs.description: Color adverbs (similar to number/constant color in code themes).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorPrepositions.description: Color prepositions (similar to operator color in code themes).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorConjunctions.description: Color conjunctions (similar to keyword color in code themes).

wordcraft.highlighting.colorPronouns.description: Color pronouns (similar to variable color in code themes).
